title: Bayesian Causal Forests for Zero-Inflated Continuous Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2610.18889v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating (heterogeneous) treatment effects is still challenging when the outcome is semicontinuous (i.e., exhibiting both a discrete point mass at zero and a skewed continuous distribution for positive values), despite the strong presence of this data type in real world settings. Existing methods either ignore the zero mass, impose fragile parametric assumptions, or suffer from extreme computational costs and data augmentation noise. This paper proposes Zero-Inflated Continuous Bayesian Causal Forests with Duan's Smearing (ZIC-BCF-Smear), a decoupled two-part nonparametric estimator that fits a Probit BCF on the full sample to model participation and a Gaussian BCF strictly on the active subpopulation to model positive intensity. Subpopulation Propensity Adjustment (SPA) mitigates regularization-induced confounding within the active subpopulation, and Duan's non-parametric smearing estimator re-transforms predictions to the response

translated_title: 面向零膨胀连续结果的贝叶斯因果森林
translated_abstract: 当结果变量为半连续型（即在零处呈现离散点质量，而正值部分呈现偏态的连续分布）时，估计（异质性）处理效应仍然极具挑战性，尽管这种数据类型在现实世界场景中广泛存在。现有方法要么忽略零值点质量，要么施加脆弱的参数化假设，要么面临极高的计算成本和数据增强噪声。本文提出了带有Duan平滑估计的零膨胀连续贝叶斯因果森林，这是一种解耦的两部分非参数估计器：在完整样本上拟合Probit BCF以建模参与（是否取零值），并严格在活跃子群体上拟合高斯BCF以建模正值的强度。子群体倾向得分调整缓解了活跃子群体内部由正则化引起的混杂，而Duan的非参数平滑估计器则将预测重新转换回响应尺度。
tldr: 本文提出ZIC-BCF-Smear方法，通过解耦的两部分贝叶斯因果森林（Probit BCF建模零值参与、高斯BCF建模正值强度），结合子群体倾向得分调整与Duan非参数平滑估计，有效解决了半连续结果下异质性处理效应估计的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ZIC-BCF-Smear, a decoupled two-part nonparametric estimator combining a Probit BCF for zero participation and a Gaussian BCF for positive intensity, with Subpopulation Propensity Adjustment and Duan's smearing, to effectively estimate heterogeneous treatment effects for semicontinuous outcomes.
